Extreme close-up of a picker's weathered hands selecting red cherries. Wet mill or raised drying beds photographed mid-process, real equipment, real workers, natural light. Varietal name and altitude typeset in clean serif over the image.
Center panel, The Transformation: Burlap sacks stacked in a warehouse, origin ink stamps in focus. Interior of a roastery drum roaster glowing amber through a porthole, heat haze visible. A minimal line graph of the roast curve overlaid in white type, first crack and second crack marked as timestamps. Macro shot of roasted beans mid-pour, steam catching side light.

The camera is held at a slightly high angle with an arm-extended perspective, using a wide-angle smartphone lens (around 24–28mm). The framing shows her from head to mid-torso, with sharp focus on her face and a slightly softer background.

She has fair-light skin with warm-neutral undertones, smooth natural texture, and a subtle glow from soft daylight. Her cheeks have a gentle pink flush. Her face is oval-shaped with a soft jawline, medium forehead, slightly full cheeks, and a rounded chin.

Her eyes are light green with hints of hazel, almond-shaped, with long defined lashes and mascara. Her eyebrows are light brown, medium thickness, softly arched, and well-groomed. She has a straight nose with a slightly rounded tip, proportional in size. Her lips are full (especially the lower lip), natural pink in color, with a slightly glossy hydrated look. She is smiling naturally with visible straight white teeth, giving a friendly, confident, relaxed expression, with slightly squinting eyes due to the smile.

Her hair is shoulder-length, dark blonde with lighter blonde highlights (balayage), styled in soft waves with a center part, naturally framing her face.

She has a slim to average build, visible from head to mid-torso, with a relaxed posture slightly angled toward the camera.

She is wearing a fitted white short-sleeve t-shirt made of soft cotton, slightly stretchy, tightly fitted. The shirt has bold red block serif text in all caps on the chest reading: “YES THEY ARE REAL”. She also wears a thin gold chain necklace with a small subtle pendant.

The lighting is natural daylight coming from the front-left, soft and diffused, creating even illumination on her face with gentle shadows and natural highlights.

The background is an indoor home setting, likely a kitchen/living area. Visible elements include a light-colored kitchen counter, white modern bar stools, a dark refrigerator (black or stainless steel) with small items or magnets attached, muted green/gray walls, light brown wooden door trim, and medium warm brown wooden flooring. The background has moderate depth and is slightly blurred.

The overall color palette includes white, red, natural skin tones, green-gray walls, wood browns, and dark appliance tones. The image style is highly realistic with minimal editing, high clarity, low noise, and natural contrast.

prompts.prompt: 在保持精确构图和色彩的同时，增强并提升图像质量。去除模糊，使肌肤呈现逼真细腻的质感：清晰的毛孔、细腻的纹路以及自然的光影过渡。保留浅色调和背景，并优化眼部、睫毛、嘴唇和发丝周围的边缘锐度，使人像照片拥有高端美妆摄影般的质感，呈现自然不做作的肌肤效果
prompts.translatedPrompt: 在保持精确构图和色彩的同时，提升并改善图像质量。去除模糊，使皮肤呈现逼真细腻的质感：毛孔清晰可见，细纹自然，光影过渡柔和。保留浅色调和背景，并优化眼睛、睫毛、嘴唇和头发周围的边缘锐度，使肖像具有高端美妆摄影的质感，呈现自然不做作的皮肤效果。

prompts.description: 一个高度详细的提示，用于生成一张 Y2K 偷拍数码相机摄影风格的年轻女性唯美肖像，要求面部与参考图 100% 一致，并指定姿势、妆容、服装、配饰、背景以及胶片颗粒和闪光灯等相机缺陷。
prompts.prompt:
Create an aesthetic portrait of a young woman in the style of Y2K candid digital camera photography, a cozy, aesthetic room setting similar to Tumblr or Pinterest photos, taken with an old digital camera with a flash to create the signature effect of 2000s digital camera photos.
The face must be 100% identical to the original reference face. Do not alter the facial shape, eyes, nose, lips, or facial features.
Pose:
She sits on the bed, holding a small silver-black camera forward slightly close to her face, as if preparing to take a photo. Her gaze is soft and slightly playful, her head slightly tilted and her shoulders relaxed. She smiles softly at the camera.

Makeup:
Soft, natural glam makeup with glowing, glass-like skin: flawless foundation, soft pink blush on the cheeks, subtle highlighter on the nose and cheekbones, thin, elongated black eyeliner, long, curly eyelashes, soft shimmering brown eyeshadow, neat, natural eyebrows, and a glossy, rosy pink lip that looks juicy and healthy.

Hair:
Black hair parted in a messy, fluffy style.

 Outfit:
A black tank top with thin straps, paired with an oversized cream hoodie that zips up to her chest and opens at one shoulder to reveal her black tank top.
A pair of thick, casual cream pants (not jogger pants) with no elastic at the bottom.

Accessories:
Transparent, cat-eye style glasses with black handles.
A small gold necklace with a minimalist pendant.

Background:
Aesthetic bedroom with a white bed sheet, no backrest, and white pillows and bolsters near the wall.
The white walls are covered with movie posters and vintage aesthetic posters from the 80s.

Lighting:
Direct camera flash, like a digital camera photo, provides bright highlights on the face and soft shadows behind.

Camera Imperfections:
Moderate film grain, slight digital noise, slight chromatic aberration, fine vignette, reddish light leak in the corners of the frame, and slightly soft focus, typical of older digital cameras.
prompts.translatedPrompt:
创作一张年轻女性的唯美肖像，风格为 Y2K 偷拍数码相机摄影，置身于温馨、唯美的房间，类似 Tumblr 或 Pinterest 上的照片，使用老式数码相机拍摄，并使用闪光灯营造出 2000 年代数码相机照片的标志性效果。
面部必须与原始参考面部 100% 一致。请勿改变面部形状、眼睛、鼻子、嘴唇或面部特征。
姿势：
她坐在床上，手持一个银黑色的小相机，稍微靠近脸部，仿佛正准备拍照。她的目光柔和而略带俏皮，头部微微倾斜，肩膀放松。她对着镜头轻轻微笑。

妆容：
柔和、自然的魅力妆容，肌肤光泽如玻璃般：无瑕的粉底，脸颊上涂抹柔和的粉色腮红，鼻梁和颧骨处有微妙的高光，细长黑色眼线，卷翘的睫毛，柔和闪烁的棕色眼影，整洁自然的眉毛，以及水润健康的玫瑰粉色唇彩。

发型：
黑色头发，凌乱蓬松的分发。

服装：
一件黑色细肩带背心，搭配一件超大款米色连帽衫，拉链拉至胸部，一侧肩膀敞开，露出黑色背心。
一条厚实、休闲的米色长裤（非慢跑裤），裤脚无松紧带。

配饰：
透明猫眼式眼镜，黑色镜腿。
一条带有简约吊坠的小金项链。

背景：
唯美的卧室，白色床单，无床头板，靠墙放置白色枕头和长枕。
白墙上贴满了电影海报和 80 年代复古唯美海报。

灯光：
直射相机闪光灯，如同数码相机照片，在面部提供明亮的高光，并在其后方产生柔和的阴影。

相机瑕疵：
适度的胶片颗粒感、轻微的数码噪点、轻微的色差、精细的暗角、画面角落的微红色漏光，以及略微柔和的焦点，这些都是老式数码相机的典型特征。
